# requires: wire
#
# The binding must not break the download it protects. The same record as
# deputy-credential, on a machine that binds "hf" to the fixture's host: the
# token goes out, the gate opens, and the bytes are proven. Without this the
# previous scenario passes on an implementation that never sends a credential
# at all -- which is what one of the three did until this was written.
credential hf 127.0.0.1
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:gated cred=hf
run A alpha

# expect 3: ok state=transferred [DL-R29]
